newsitem.title: USA: Barney's requests exclusivity extension to Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: Barney's requests exclusivity extension to Sept 5.

text.p: Men's clothing retailer Barney's Inc said Monday it has again asked the U.S. Bankruptcy Court to extend the company's exclusivity period.

The company said the filing was made contemplating that a definitive investment agreement will be reached by May 28 in connection with the motion for "investor protections" which was filed earlier this month.

Barney said it asked the court to extend the period in whcih it has the exclusive right to file a plan of reorganization through September 5 from May 5 and further requested an extension of its exclusive right to solicit acceptances of its plan through November 4.

The company said the investor protection motion contemplates a definitive investment agreement by May 28, adding the process of obtaining court approval is likely to take at least an additional month.
The requested extension, Barney's said, would provide about two months during July and August to prepare and file a reorganization plan and disclosure statement.
